items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: And sometimes it'd get my sister Billy, Ida, and Edna, either one of them, that you could play for.

ctx.x: Mary Mack? Yeah. Billy and Mary Mack?

Yeah. Did you play with that show? Yeah. They used to come to Pensacola. You see what they used to do, all of them there, vaudeville people, you know, shows, they used to come through Pensacola, and they always would stop at the Belmont Theater. And sometimes they'd have their own piano piano piano, and sometimes they didn't. So they always got the good to one of the good to one of the girls. So I would have to be one of them, at the time some of them, and then sometimes it'd get my sister Billy, Ida, and Edna,…
